newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: URA closes tender for three 99-year land parcels.
newsitem.headline: URA closes tender for three 99-year land parcels.

text.p: The Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) closed a public tender on Wednesday for three 99-year leasehold parcels of land for residential housing.
It said in a statement that MCL Land Ltd put in the top bid of Singapore $61.79 million for a 21,800 sq m plot at Mugliston Park in the northern part of the island.
MCL Land also put in the top bid of S$40.3 million for a 14,000 sq m plot in the same area, the statement said.
It said LKN Development Pte Ltd offered the top bid of S$44.7 million for a 5,670 sq m plot at Geylang in the eastern part of Singapore.
